They only go for the check-up!
We went there for the first time and the last time. 40 thousand is the basic "examination", which involves sitting across from each other and the doctor telling us the possible causes of allergies... thank you, I've read this about 20 times online. The problem is not that she informed me, but that she didn't do any actual examination besides that! I said that the dog's body is always hot, I would think that the first thing to do after that would be to take the temperature... no way! She didn't touch the dog except to pet it and then she said that we should try the hypoallergenic diet and see you later... I waited for the actual examination to finally start, like skin scrapings, blood tests, etc.... cytology if needed or anything that can be used as a starting point... I will never recommend it to anyone again. They really don't want to do anything besides smile and take your money.
Dr. Zsófia Koltai's knowledge is a priceless treasure. And the assistants bring such calm and kindness to my cat and me that it is a true blessing during these difficult days.

I would like to emphasize that we arrived at the clinic with complete confidence no matter how many times we went there. Despite this, such unnecessary and life-threatening treatments were prescribed for a minor cold that at another veterinary clinic they told us, pale, not to give this to our dog because it could have very serious side effects!!! During the oncology examination, they refused to take cytology for abnormalities that seemed suspicious or were recommended for examination by other places, citing the fact that I quote "it can wait". The treatment plan is issued and no appeal is accepted afterwards. They do not care if the owner indicates that the dog is not doing well, has a problem, etc. Everything is directed to the owner, who, as a layman, does not even know where to run with his sick pet. They like to make the owner feel guilty after they have done everything, given the medications she prescribed, and indicated that these medications have serious side effects. Dr. Koltai's reaction after this was to call us at the top of her lungs, screaming that we should never come to her office or her staff again, because we can't do anything about it!!!! Unfortunately, we felt like we were bothering her and were slowly being labeled as bullies because we dared to say that our beloved pet was not well. Everyone should be very careful, they are nice on the surface, but it's unbelievable how manipulative and abusive they become as soon as you express that you need any help or advice for your pet!!!
Although my puppy is already waiting at the Rainbow Bridge, I would like to thank you very much for the humane and helpful attitude we experienced here. ❤️🙏❤️ …

We visited Dr. Sára Heinik with my dog ​​Füles. We were greeted by kind, smiling receptionists. You can wait inside or outside in the yard.
We had a consultation with the doctor and I could give her a thousand stars! She explained the essence of the disease, its development, current situation and future with incredible detail and thoroughness. She shared even the smallest thoughts with us. The examination was also very attentive and careful.
The doctor is a kind, smiling, thorough, perfect doctor! She told us that they discuss the medical records of the animals that arrive there as a team and that makes it even more perfect!
Thank you for everything!❤️
I think it's the most expensive animal clinic in the country! The time is for information only. 1 hour wait.

The assistants were extremely kind and helpful.
I was disappointed in the orthopedic doctor.
After he x-rayed my cat, he said that he had metastatic cancer and that it was best to put him down, all very quickly because he didn't understand. Before the examination, he asked if he was always this unfriendly, so I told him that he was the 5th vet to examine him in 2 weeks and that he could barely stand it anymore, which I don't admire in retrospect, because his shoulder bone was almost gone, his disease was so advanced.
The cost of this was 93,000 HUF, which is quite expensive, but at least he is no longer suffering.

If there are angels who have come to earth, they can be found here😻
Doctor Sára and Alma for sure.
What they do for our cat Tomi, the way they treat him. They have restored my faith that there are still good and empathetic people. Thank you very much.❤️ …

I read a lot of positive reviews about Duo-Vet, in my opinion they have room for improvement. They said there would be a 20-minute wait at the clinic, which turned into a 60-minute wait. I waited patiently, hoping and trusting in a positive diagnosis, hoping that our cat was not beyond saving. I do not question their professional preparedness, very kind assistants helped with the examination of the cat, and the doctor also told me everything I needed to know. When the doctor told me how much I had to pay, I was shocked! They are overpriced, the lack of empathy is very noticeable. I did not want a free examination and opinion, but affordable prices. I do not know exactly and I do not care what they charged me, but 47,000.- is an incorrect price. Yes, you have to pay for professional care, but asking for such an amount for an unsaveable cat... well, for me, humanity is zero. Before Duo Vet, I went to two other places with the kitten, they didn't charge me a single forint, even though the kitten was examined and even given antibiotics! At Dou Vet, the kitten did get two injections and the assistant is truly a fairy, but this amount is unfair to me. Unfortunately, not everyone can afford this cost, so everyone who goes there should get informed and ask for information about how much it costs. I looked at the prices online, but unfortunately not thoroughly enough!

The doctor recommended immediate anesthesia, which I didn't ask for out of fairness. Our kitten lived for another 37 days after that, she was under my care the whole time, we accompanied her throughout her illness. The kitten was active the whole time, in her last days she ran out of vitality. I took her to another place for treatment, where they kindly didn't charge almost any costs. The kitten had wonderful weeks from us! Accepting immediate anesthesia should be reconsidered!

It is terribly outrageous that, because of the information that it is not possible to use chemotherapy on a cat next to an infant, elderly, or sick person, the animal had to be taken away, exposed to additional stress, even though its own veterinarian had asked about it beforehand. It was clearly not possible to charge 47,000 HUF for a consultation. This makes you wonder how many unnecessary and painful procedures are performed, just for money. Humanity, love for animals

Today we were with my dog ​​Füge, I can only say very good things. I contacted Duo-Vet by phone a few days ago, for a second opinion.

I sent the results, medical history, and they called us 2 days later, we got an appointment quickly, and they even took into account that Füge is very stressed, so we got a sedative in advance (!).

Füge is 14 years old, but this was our best veterinary experience so far. We had an ultrasound, they were professional, fast, kind - with both the owner and the dog.

They sent us to a dentist, we got 2 addresses, we are very satisfied - both humanly and professionally!

Well, actually, it's a little strange to me that I called them and said I have a dog with cancer, I sent them a photo of the cancer, and they weren't able to say anything, a consultation costs 47,000 HUF, I understand that we live on money, but I think this is unfair to the animal, I don't regret the money but this is a joke what they are doing! Of course, animal love. When 4 veterinarians tried to help the dog and they just guessed, for hundreds of thousands of forints, how can you trust them??? I definitely won't take my dog ​​here!!!

There are many pets and many things have changed, I won't even comment on the money issues because everyone can decide what amount to spend or look for another institution.

The order is good. The staff are also very busy and many things have to be done well, which is often not spoiled by the busy ants.

This is it, we must accept that in 2025 the veterinary profession in Hungary will reach the point where the care of a dog is no longer based on trust like Charlie the monkey at the house, but rather a relationship that is not worthy, unfortunately, healing no longer begins with a smile, but from the lines of books and the various sponsors, drug manufacturers, whatever.

The problem is that medical ethics are 0 because they don't touch the animal! This is horrible because a doctor should love the animal, not just the books. The other problem is the overly driven robots who try but work without practice and experience so that they have no idea when which animal is being treated, but it's mostly my fault that I give money to someone who doesn't care if they treat hundreds of dogs a day! And the drug lobby is doing its thing here too.
We have been coming here for years, now with our second dog. We have experienced maximum professional knowledge and love for animals.

On 04/01/2025, we visited DUO-VET with my dog. He had to undergo a fairly serious surgery. The calm, composed handling of the situation by the veterinary team was reassuring. It was clear that they were very professional. Marcipán would like to thank the DUO-VET team for the successful procedure. He has been rehabilitating at home since then. 😊
I can only recommend it to everyone.

Academic arrogance, protocol-based, schematic thinking, resulting in shortsightedness. Veterinary printer. I won't even mention the money, because I don't care about that.
But I hear there is a "growing market demand", let's look for Dr. Zsófia Koltai's "Frequently made mistakes in primary oncology care" among hers (first hit on Google).
Dr. Google is really informative, damn it, right? Transparency has become, oh my, there are no more inaccessible secret mystical medical doctrines. What a shame, huh?
Someone should do a webinar titled "Frequently made mistakes in medical care". Let's say a self-critical doctor admitting his mistake. Oh, that doesn't really exist.
My verdict: wrongdoing by negligent omission.
My deepest congratulations. Then they could insert us into a nice spreadsheet, maybe we'll be a case study at the next webinar, along with a vodka martini joke.
It's a shame, because on the surface he seemed professional. But it seems that's just because of his blatant self-confidence.
We came to this clinic in a vulnerable, desperate situation. (The only commendable thing is that they welcomed us with urgency.)
I regretted it, but really. And my poor, even more vulnerable animal regretted it even more, because it left this money-smelling conveyor belt world.
He might have had to die, but not NOW and not AFTER, because they completely ignored a constantly deteriorating current condition, due to his tube vision. In the end, the poor thing had to be put to sleep, somewhere else, in the midst of suffering. And then the chief wise guy tells me, while I'm calling on the phone, almost crying, that the animal is dying, to "sum up briefly, because I'm in the countryside." By the way, on a Saturday, when the clinic has an appointment time.
Congratulations.
Summary:
Due to the bottleneck of the painful outcome: you failed.
You can sit down, everyone.
For the sake of completeness: in our case, the reception, the assistance were fine, and the flexibility of scheduling an appointment was also good.
The above lines reflect my personal opinion formed taking into account objective facts (this also includes professional confirmation from other places) and apply exclusively to the case of my animal, not to the operation or professional competence of the clinic as a whole. I trust that there are doctors, both veterinary and human doctors, in this clinic and elsewhere, in human care as well, who have not only their minds but also their hearts in wanting to heal. And they do not just follow convenient protocols, but also look at an individual case. And they see, of course. Although I am increasingly skeptical. And when I look at the animal's grave, to this day I burst into tears and helpless rage.

I am completely satisfied with the Duo-Vet clinic, the staff, the care and my full appreciation to our doctor, Dr. Zsófia Koltai.

I went to see Dr. Koltai with my Rottweiler, she was very fair and straightforward. Since she communicated everything clearly, I went in for the surgery. It was successful and she has been living happily and healthily ever since, thank you …

My experiences are mixed, but fortunately not nearly as bad as some of the tragic losses of owners I read here.
